pipelines.name: Linting & tests

steps.name: Install with type-checking tools, stubs & minimal test libraries
Install with linting tools & minimal test libraries
Check code & tests meet black standards
Checkout PR branch and all PR commits
Run gitlint
steps.run: git fetch https://github.com/zulip/zulip-terminal main; gitlint --commits FETCH_HEAD..${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

steps.name: Ensure regular package installs from checkout
Run check-branch
steps.run: git fetch https://github.com/zulip/zulip-terminal main; CHECK="pip install .[linting,testing,typing] && ./tools/lint-all && pytest" ./tools/check-branch FETCH_HEAD

steps.name: Ensure libxml-related libraries are installed (some pypy versions don't have wheels)
Ensure regular package installs from checkout
Check we detect the python environment correctly
steps.run: python -c "from zulipterminal.platform_code import detected_python_short; import os; e, d = os.environ['PYTHON'], detected_python_short(); assert d == e, f'{d} != {e}'"

steps.name: Check we detect the platform correctly
steps.run: python -c "from zulipterminal.platform_code import detected_platform; import os; e, d = os.environ['EXPECT'], detected_platform(); assert d == e, f'{d} != {e}'"
